([[Chairman]], [[Managing director|MD]] and [[CEO]]) *Priyaranjan
([[CFO]])https://hrnxt.com/news/executive-moves/sasken-names-priyaranjan-as-cfo-b-ramkumar-as-chief-risk-officer/51049/2022/08/10/}} | industry = {{Unbulleted list|[[Technology company|Technology]]}} | services = {{plainlist| *[[Product engineering]] *[[Digital transformation]]}} | revenue = {{profit}} {{INR}} 504.31 crores ([[Fiscal year|FY]] 18–19) | net_income = {{profit}} {{INR}} 90.42 crores ([[Fiscal year|FY]] 18–19) | num_employees = 2,000 (March 2019) | website = {{URL|https://www.sasken.com}} }} '''Sasken Technologies Limited''' (formerly '''Sasken Communication Technologies Limited''') is an Indian [[Multinational corporation|multinational]] technology services company, based in [[Bengaluru]]. == Origin == Sasken was founded by Rajiv C Mody, its chairman & MD, and three other co-founders: Krishna Jhaveri, Suresh Dholakia, and Badruddin Agarwala. Sasken came into being as '''Silicon Automation Systems''' in 1989 in a small warehouse in [[Fremont, California|Fremont]], [[California]]. Later, the company changed its name to '''Sasken Communication Technologies Limited'''. The name 'Sasken' is a portmanteau of its original name (SAS) and 'ken', the Scottish word for knowledge. Sasken acquired the operations of Blue Broadband Technologies in 2005, creating Sasken Network Engineering Limited (SNEL).{{Cite news|date=2005-02-19|title=Sasken acquires firm to foray into telecom network management|work=Business Standard India|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/technology/sasken-acquires-firm-to-foray-into-telecom-network-management-105021901049_1.html|access-date=2021-04-14}} Sasken acquired iSoftTech Private Limited, Chennai in June 2006.{{Cite news|title=Sasken acquires iSoftTech for $1.5m|work=The Economic Times|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/articleshow/1479902.cms|access-date=2021-04-14}} In September 2006, Sasken acquired the Finnish company Botnia Hightech [[Osakeyhtiö|Oy]], now known as Sasken Finland [[Osakeyhtiö|Oy]].{{Cite news|title=Sasken acquires Finland-based co in all cash deal|work=The Economic Times|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/telecom/sasken-acquires-finland-based-co-in-all-cash-deal/articleshow/1812910.cms|access-date=2021-04-14}} On 24 January 2007, Sasken entered into a joint venture with Tata Autocomp, known as TACO Sasken Automotive Electronics Pvt Ltd (TSAE).{{Cite news|last=Reporter|first=B. S.|date=2007-01-26|title=Sasken enters into JV with Tata AutoComp|work=Business Standard India|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/sasken-enters-into-jv-with-tata-autocomp-107012601101_1.html|access-date=2021-04-14}} In February 2017, Sasken Communication Technologies Limited announced that it had changed its name to Sasken Technologies Limited.{{Cite web|title=Sasken Communication Technologies Limited announces corporate name change to Sasken Technologies Limited to reflect its broad range of services|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/announcements/others/sasken-communication-technologies-limited-announces-corporate-name-change-to-sasken-technologies-limited-to-reflect-its-broad-range-of-services/article21899145.ece|access-date=2021-04-14|website=@businessline|language=en}} In January 2018, Sasken unveiled a new logo.{{Cite web |date=2018-01-25 |title=Sasken unveils new logo to reflect its 30-year-old heritage |url=https://www.dqchannels.com/sasken-unveils-new-logo-reflect-30-year-old-heritage/ |access-date=2023-08-06 |website=-DQChannels |language=en-US}} In July 2022, Sasken announced that Abhijit Kabra was appointed as the CEO.{{Cite web |date=2022-07-20 |title=Sasken appoints Abhijit Kabra as its chief executive officer |url=https://equitybulls.com/category.php?id=316737 |access-date=2022-07-21 |website=EquityBulls}} In June 2024, Sasken's board designated Rajiv C. Mody as CEO in addition to his existing position of chairman and managing director.{{cite web |title=CMD Rajiv C. Mody Appointed CEO of Sasken Technologies |url=https://boardstewardship.com/cmd-rajiv-c-mody-appointed-ceo-of-sasken-technologies/ |website=Board Stewardship}} In April 2025, Sasken acquired [[Borqs]], an embedded software and products company.{{cite web |title=Sasken Technologies Completes Acquisition of Borqs Technologies |url=https://www.autocarpro.in/news/sasken-technologies-completes-acquisition-of-borqs-technologies-125891}} == References == {{Reflist}} {{Authority control}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Sasken Technologies Limited}} [[Category:Software companies of India]] [[Category:Companies based in Bengaluru]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 1989]] [[Category:Software companies established in 1989]] [[Category:1989 establishments in Karnataka]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]] [[Category:Multinational companies headquartered in India]]
extract: Sasken Technologies Limited (formerly Sasken Communication Technologies Limited) is an Indian multinational technology services company, based in Bengaluru.
